listings.title: Glass and stone villa with a lit pool
description: A house of glass, concrete and stone on a level lot in the Hollywood Hills. The lawn runs straight to the edge of a heated pool, and at dusk the glazed ground floor and the pool light up together.

The living room has rounded armchairs, a cream sofa and tall black-framed windows that look into mature trees. The kitchen is built around a marble waterfall island, with wood cabinets and herringbone oak floors. Upstairs, the bedrooms look onto woodland, and the primary bath has a freestanding tub under a black-framed window.

Completed in 2019, the house has solar panels on the flat roof with battery storage in the garage. The drive is gated and there is room for two cars inside. Thomas Rowe shows the house on weekdays and Saturday mornings.
features: Freestanding tub in the primary bath
neighborhoodFacts: Quiet, winding residential streets with little through traffic.
Runyon Canyon Park and its hiking trails are in the same hills.
The restaurants and shops of Sunset Boulevard are a short drive downhill.

listings.title: Timber and glass house on Lake Washington
description: A gabled timber house with a tall glazed front, set back from the street in a mossy garden. The lot runs down to private frontage on Lake Washington, with a dock at the water's edge.

The main room is double height and painted white, with tall windows onto the trees, a dining table with bentwood chairs and a white sofa. The kitchen pairs a concrete-topped island with dark cabinetry and a gas range set beside the windows. The primary bedroom has a wood-slat headboard wall and glass on two sides, and the bathrooms are lined in timber.

The house was built in 2016 with radiant floor heating throughout and triple-glazed windows on the lake side. A detached garage has space for two cars and a workbench. Elena Marsh can show the house and the dock on weekdays or by appointment at weekends.
features: Private lake frontage with a dock
Triple-glazed windows on the lake side
Primary bedroom with glass on two sides
neighborhoodFacts: Laurelhurst sits on the west shore of Lake Washington, in northeast Seattle.
The University of Washington campus is a short drive west.
Streets are residential and tree-lined, with little through traffic.

listings.title: Four-story brownstone with a parlor bay
description: A single-family brownstone in a row of matching houses on a tree-lined Park Slope street, with a gas lamp at the stoop and shrubs in the front yard. It has four floors above a garden level and a deep rear garden.

The parlor floor has a bay window and a black wood stove, with room for armchairs and a wall of books. The kitchen keeps one wall of exposed brick, with white cabinets, a white peninsula and a lantern pendant. Upstairs there are five bedrooms, and the main bathroom has a clawfoot tub with brass taps under a window.

Built in 1899, the house had its wiring, plumbing and roof replaced in 2021, and the receipts are in the seller's file. Much of Park Slope is a designated historic district, so changes to the front of the house need approval from the city's Landmarks Preservation Commission. Clara Halden can share the full file before a viewing.
neighborhoodFacts: Prospect Park runs along the eastern edge of Park Slope.
Seventh Avenue and Fifth Avenue are the neighborhood's main streets for shops and restaurants.
Much of the neighborhood is a designated historic district.

listings.title: Penthouse with a roof terrace over the West Side

address.oneLine: 12 Halvard Place, Penthouse 58, New York, NY 10001

listings.parking: Garage parking in the building, available separately
description: A three-bedroom penthouse on the top floor of a slim glass tower on Manhattan's West Side, with a private roof terrace above it. From the living room window you look across high-rise towers to the waterfront.

The open kitchen has a white island with seating for four, gray cabinets and a sliding glass door. The primary bedroom has a slanted glass wall facing the skyscrapers. Up one flight, the roof terrace has outdoor seating behind a black iron railing, with the skyline on every side.

The building has a doorman, a fitness room and a package room, and the apartment comes unfurnished. Leases run for 12 or 24 months. Maya Chen arranges viewings, including evening visits so you can see the terrace after dark.

Kitchen island with seating for four
neighborhoodFacts: The northern end of the High Line is at Hudson Yards.
The 34 St–Hudson Yards station on the 7 line is in the neighborhood.
Hudson River Park runs along the waterfront to the west.

listings.title: Craftsman house with a deep porch and garden
description: A craftsman house with a wide porch on white columns, hanging flower baskets and a front lawn. Behind it, the garden is planted with flowering shrubs and grasses, with space for a chair in the shade.

Inside, the living room has exposed ceiling beams and a stone fireplace, with the staircase to one side. The kitchen keeps the beams and adds a butcher-block island under three pendant lights. The bedrooms are upstairs and take the low evening sun.

Built in 1924, the house was renovated in 2021, with new electrics, a new HVAC system and a second-floor bathroom added. The original porch columns and front door were kept. Daniel Reyes has the inspection report from the renovation and can walk you through it at the viewing.
features: Deep front porch on white columns
Original front door and porch columns
neighborhoodFacts: Hyde Park is one of Austin's older neighborhoods, with many early twentieth-century houses.
The University of Texas campus is just to the south.
Streets are shaded by mature trees, and many houses have front porches.

listings.title: Shingled beach house above the dune
listings.parking: Covered parking for 3 cars under the house
description: A blue-gray shingled beach house with a wide deck, raised above a dune planted with beach grass. A private boardwalk crosses the dune to the sand.

The living room is bright and plain, with a cream sofa, a rustic coffee table and French doors. The kitchen has a white island with stools and glass doors onto a covered patio. The bedrooms are calm and light, with ceiling fans, and a covered porch with white arches faces the sea.

The house was built in 2004 on pilings, with parking for three cars underneath. Owen Whitlock has the elevation certificate, the flood insurance history and the most recent wind mitigation report, and sends them to anyone who books a viewing.

The North End is mostly houses, with fewer shops than the south end of the island.

listings.title: Warehouse loft with arched windows

address.oneLine: 218 North Avelyn Street, Unit 4B, Chicago, IL 60607

description: A two-bedroom loft in a red-brick warehouse building with rows of tall arched windows. The building was converted to homes in 2003 and keeps its brick, timber and concrete.

The living space has exposed brick walls, tall windows and room for a large sofa. The kitchen has white cabinets, a double oven and track lighting on the concrete ceiling. The bedroom is quiet and simple, with a perforated metal screen, and a second sitting area has two brick columns and full afternoon light.

Both bathrooms have walk-in showers, and there is a washer and dryer in the unit. Heat and water are included in the rent; electricity is separate. Maya Chen shows the loft on weekday evenings and Saturday mornings.
neighborhoodFacts: Fulton Market's restaurants are at the northern end of the West Loop.
Morgan station on the Green and Pink lines serves the neighborhood.
Union Station is within walking distance for Metra and Amtrak trains.

listings.title: Mid-century house with a courtyard pool

address.oneLine: 1290 North Calloway Drive, Palm Springs, CA 92262

description: A low mid-century house with a zigzag roofline, set against the mountain with cactus and desert planting in front. The rooms are arranged around a walled courtyard with a round pool.

The living room has wood-framed glass walls, a low sofa and a black fireplace. The kitchen pairs walnut upper cabinets with a white island and a red range under a large window. Bedrooms have walnut and wood furniture and tall windows, and the courtyard is lit at night under whitewashed arches.

Built in 1961, the house was restored in 2018 with new glazing, a new roof membrane and updated electrics, keeping the original roofline and fireplace. Thomas Rowe can share the restoration drawings and the contractor's notes.

Black fireplace in the living room

neighborhoodFacts: Vista Las Palmas sits at the foot of the San Jacinto Mountains, west of downtown.
Palm Canyon Drive, the main street for shops and restaurants, is a short drive away.
Palm Springs holds Modernism Week, a festival of mid-century architecture, each February.

listings.title: Timber house with a stone fireplace and mountain views
description: A dark timber-clad house with tall windows and a long wood deck, set among trees on Red Mountain above Aspen. In winter the deck looks out over snow and woods.

The living room has a vaulted cedar ceiling, a stone fireplace and a large sectional sofa, with the kitchen open beyond it. The kitchen has walnut cabinets, stainless steel appliances and a long window above the sink. One bedroom has three windows onto the snowy peaks, and the main bathroom has a double stone vanity and a freestanding soaking tub under large windows.

Built in 2016, the house has radiant floor heating, a heated driveway and an attached two-car garage. Elena Marsh has the roof's snow load report and the last two winters' heating bills, and sends them to anyone who books a viewing.
features: Vaulted cedar ceiling in the living room

Downtown Aspen and the gondola up Aspen Mountain are a short drive away.
Aspen/Pitkin County Airport is a few miles northwest of town.

listings.title: Renovated farmhouse in white board and batten
description: A farmhouse in white board and batten, with a covered entry, a wood front door and a garage with glass doors. It sits on a deep lot in Inglewood, in East Nashville.

The living room has white sofas, a fireplace, black-framed windows and a black chandelier over light hardwood floors. The long kitchen has light wood cabinets with brass pulls and a large island. One bedroom has light oak floors and a long window above the bed, and a bathroom has a light wood double vanity, a freestanding tub and a glass shower.

Built in 1938, the house was renovated down to the frame in 2024, with new wiring, plumbing, HVAC, windows and roof. Daniel Reyes has the permits and the pre-listing inspection report, and goes through both with you at the viewing.

Gallatin Pike, the main road through the neighborhood, has shops and restaurants.
Shelby Bottoms Greenway and Nature Park, along the Cumberland River, is a short drive away.

The living room has teal walls, a bay window and hardwood floors, with room for a sofa and an armchair. The kitchen keeps its vintage wooden cabinets and tiled backsplash, with a gas range.
